title: Questions and negation
explanation:
A spoken question can use the same words as a statement, with the voice going up. In writing, Spanish adds ¿ at the start and ? at the end.

No comes directly before the verb: no quiero café, no estoy en casa. The written marks are optional for the checker. The accent on dónde and qué is not optional.
commonMistake: Putting no after the verb, or writing donde without the accent when you mean where.
